collector.command: read sealed passive snapshot and/or fetch upstream source control

evidence-points: plaintext trace behavior is not the fixed expectation

payload.excerpt: on(s) Applicable Editions IBM® Db2® 11.5.0 - 11.5.9 Server IBM® Db2® 12.1.0 - 12.1.5 Server All platforms are affected. Remediation/Fixes Customers running any vulnerable affected level of an affected Program, V11.5, and V12.1, can download the security update containing the interim fix for this issue from Fix Central. These security updates are available based on the most recent level for each impacted release: V11.5.9, V12.1.4 and V12.1.5. They can be applied to any affected level of the appropriate release to remediate this vulnerability.
